temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something and tells Christian he is in some trouble; he did not know how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him and feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jonathan confirms he was hiding something and reveals that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, concerned, suspicious but somewhat validated.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and find out what is going on so he can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but eventually accepts support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian learns the trouble is complicated, Jonathan is reluctant to involve him, but Jonathan will accept support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs Christian's support and resources to resolve a complicated trouble; they can face it together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, including providing resources to get him out of the mess.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure whether the trouble is illegal, admits he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and needs Christian's support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian begins to suspect criminal or dangerous involvement, then learns Jonathan may have been involved with wrong people while denying illegal acts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong or dangerous people, although he claims he did nothing illegal; the matter needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly and ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan he believes Jonathan is being framed; Christian has some leads but not the culprit yet and plans to gather evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may involve wrong or dangerous people, and it is unclear whether Jonathan is guilty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian's investigation indicates Jonathan is being framed rather than guilty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by an unknown person; more evidence is needed to prove it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Determined, protective, and concerned for Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan he has found out who is behind it: someone both of them know and trust. Jonathan reacts with shock and warns that the person is dangerous, but says he trusts Christian to do what is right.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed, but the culprit is unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian identifies the culprit as someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A trusted mutual acquaintance is responsible for framing Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Betrayed, resolute, and protective, with underlying anger.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
